stationSpecificFees.reason: DEW21 publishes a 0.03 EUR/min blocking fee for its own infrastructure, capped at 12 EUR, starting 30 minutes after charging ends, but explicitly exempts lantern chargers and sites with separate parking fees. The same official page currently contains an AC time-window discrepancy (price section 08:00-20:00; FAQ 10:00-20:00), so this fee must not be applied globally until resolved per station/source.

roaming.note: DEW21 states external roaming in the fahr-e app was disabled on 2026-07-31; the app now starts sessions only at DEW21 charging points.

note: Official DEW21 page still labels the energy-price table Stand 01.01.2025 but presents it under 'Unsere aktuellen Preise' and confirms on the same current page that, after 2026-07-31, fahr-e sessions are limited to DEW21 points. Energy prices are therefore retained as current verified own-network prices; station-dependent blocking fees remain deferred.
